name: Sarah Sowden
role: Senior Clinical Lecturer & Honorary Consultant in Public Health
researchKeywords: health and care inequalities, Deep End primary care, public health workforce, research capacity
bio: Dr Sarah Sowden, MA(Oxf), MPH, PhD, FFPH, FHEA is a Clinical Senior Lecturer and Honorary Consultant in Public Health. Her work combines research leadership, workforce development and system-wide collaboration to improve health and care equity.
researchFocus: Sarah leads research focused on reducing health and care inequalities. Her Deep End programme and UNFAIR study examine what works to improve health and care equity and support collaboration across research, practice and health systems.
